1. (Currently Amended) A method for content optimization, comprising: receiving a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the rule on probability factor, wherein the plurality of pieces of content are generated with __specific technical parameters that control display characteristics including layout, timing, and visual rendering of content elements__; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use; determining, by a processor, an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; and modifying, by the processor, the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated performance data, wherein the modifying step comprises __automatically adjusting probability distributions to optimize content presentation based on measured performance metrics that indicate user engagement or conversion rates__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a size or position adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, and wherein __the content element comprises a visual component with defined dimensions and positioning coordinates within a display interface__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for aggregated performance data the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, and wherein __the deviation value is calculated as a statistical variance or standard deviation of performance metrics across the plurality of pieces of content, and the modifying step includes adjusting probability weights inversely proportional to the deviation value to reduce performance variability__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving a set of rules for content generation; identifying a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation; and composing, by the processor, one or more rules on probability factor for the changeable content attribute, wherein __the composing step comprises analyzing historical performance data to determine which content attributes have the greatest impact on optimization objectives before generating the one or more rules on probability factor__.

8. (Currently Amended) A content optimization system, comprising: a rule management module maintaining a set of rules for content generation, the set of rules comprising a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; a content generation module operative to generate a plurality of pieces of content based on the set of rules, the plurality of pieces of content designed with a particular optimization objective, wherein __the content generation module applies the probability factor rules to control specific technical parameters of content rendering including visual layout, element positioning, timing sequences, and transition effects__; and a content evaluation module operative to evaluate content performance on reaching the particular optimization objective based on data acquired when the plurality of pieces of content are displayed, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the evaluated content performance, wherein the rule management module is operative to amend the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated content performance data, and wherein __the rule management module implements a feedback loop that continuously refines probability distributions based on measured performance metrics including user engagement rates, conversion rates, or other quantifiable optimization indicators__.

9. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, and wherein __the content element attribute comprises a visual component with defined dimensions, positioning coordinates, color values, or typography specifications within a display interface__.

10. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine a deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, and wherein the rule management module is further operative to modify the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, and wherein __the deviation value represents a statistical measure of variance in performance metrics, and the rule management module adjusts probability weights to reduce performance variability based on the calculated deviation value__.

11. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the rule management module is further operative to identify a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation and compose a rule on probability factor for the changeable content attribute, and wherein __the rule management module analyzes historical performance data to determine which content attributes have measurable impact on the particular optimization objective before composing the rule on probability factor__.

13. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: receiving a first rule on probability factor and a second rule on probability factor, the first rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a first value of a selected content attribute, the second rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a second value of the selected content attribute, the second value being different from the first value; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor, wherein __the plurality of pieces of content are generated with specific technical parameters that control display characteristics including layout, timing, and visual rendering of content elements__; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use; determining, by a processor, a first aggregated performance data for the first value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; determining, by the processor, a second aggregated performance data for the second value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; and modifying, by the processor, the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the second aggregated performance data, wherein __the modifying step comprises automatically adjusting probability distributions to optimize content presentation based on measured performance metrics that indicate user engagement or conversion rates__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, and wherein __the content element comprises a visual component with defined dimensions and positioning coordinates within a display interface__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the first rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, and wherein __the deviation value is calculated as a statistical variance or standard deviation of performance metrics across the plurality of pieces of content, and the modifying step includes adjusting probability weights inversely proportional to the deviation value to reduce performance variability__.
